description: Reviewed npm audit advisories for production dependencies (npm audit --omit=dev). scripts/verify-audit.mjs fails on any high/critical advisory not listed here. Categories: not-applicable (the vulnerable path is not used), existing-decision (a recorded roadmap decision covers it), deferred (real but needs a major upgrade, planned separately). Add an advisory only after reviewing it; remove entries once the package is upgraded. See docs/REFACTORING_ROADMAP.md, "의존성 취약점 분류".

entries.reason: Cross-origin redirect leaking PRIVATE-TOKEN/Authorization: the update feed carries no tokens. electron-updater stays pinned (decision D8).

Windows code-signing bypass: installers have no Authenticode signature (electron-builder.intranet.yml); updates are protected by the Ed25519-signed feed + sha512 check (HF8). electron-updater is not upgraded (decision D8, Electron 22 compatibility).

Fix is zod 4 (major, all shared contracts). Client-side zod validates server responses only. Mitigation on the server: express.json 10 MB limit and authentication on almost every route. Whether zod 3 is affected is unconfirmed (advisory range <4.6.6).
Used by @mapbox/node-pre-gyp only while bcrypt 5 installs (Docker image build); never at runtime. Fix is bcrypt 6 (major, drops node-pre-gyp) — deferred.

Fix is zod 4 (major, all shared contracts). Mitigation: express.json body limit 10 MB (JSON_BODY_LIMIT) and authentication on almost every route. Whether zod 3 is affected is unconfirmed (advisory range <4.6.6).
